name: List Files
description: List files from a specific folder. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/reference/files/list) for more information

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: folderId
configurable_props.label: Parent Folder
configurable_props.description: The ID of the parent folder which contains the file. If not specified, it will list files from the drive's top-level folder.

configurable_props.name: fields
configurable_props.label: Fields
configurable_props.description:
The fields you want included in the response [(see the documentation for available fields)](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files). If not specified, the response includes a default set of fields specific to this method. For development you can use the special value `*` to return all fields, but you'll achieve greater performance by only selecting the fields you need.

**eg:** `files(id,mimeType,name,webContentLink,webViewLink)`

configurable_props.name: filterText
configurable_props.label: Filter Text
configurable_props.description: Filter by file name that contains a specific text

configurable_props.name: trashed
configurable_props.label: Trashed
configurable_props.description: If `true`, list **only** trashed files. If `false`, list **only** non-trashed files. Keep it empty to include both.
